# Spartan Logistics Expands Toledo Presence Through Strategic Acquisition

PR Newswire

WHITEHOUSE, Ohio, Sept. 9, 2026

WHITEHOUSE, Ohio, Sept. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ — Spartan Logistics, a family-owned third-party logistics provider specializing in warehousing and transportation services, today announces the acquisition of Allen Logistics, a warehousing company supporting customers in Whitehouse, Ohio. The acquisition became effective September 1, 2026.

 

The acquisition adds 100,000 SF of warehousing capacity to Spartan’s existing Toledo operations as the seventh warehouse operation in Northwest Ohio, a market that has been an important part of Spartan’s network and long-term growth strategy. This brings the company to 4.5 million SF of total space and 950,000 SF in Northwest Ohio.

Spartan is focused on providing a seamless transition for existing customers and providing resources, technology, and efficiencies to the facility, while also identifying opportunities to bring additional business to the operation.

“Toledo has been a key market for Spartan for many years, and this acquisition represents another investment in our future here,” said Steve Harmon, Chief Executive Officer of Spartan Logistics. “We’re excited about the opportunity to welcome a strong group of employees and customers to Spartan and build on the relationships and operations that have already been established.”

The transaction, brokered in an off-market deal by NAI Harmon Group, included the real estate located at 6245 Industrial Drive in Whitehouse, Ohio, with ideal access to Swanton, Napoleon, and Perrysburg. WesBanco provided acquisition financing for the transaction.

“WesBanco is proud to serve as Spartan’s financial partner, helping them achieve this important milestone, said Joel Jerger, WesBanco Market President, Toledo. “Helping businesses grow and succeed is central to our mission, and we are pleased to partner with organizations like Spartan that contribute to the strength and vitality of communities across Northwest Ohio.” 

The addition of the facility complements Spartan’s operations in Toledo and strengthens the company’s ability to serve manufacturers, distributors, and other businesses across Northwest Ohio and the broader Midwest. “This transaction is a perfect fit given our commitment to Northwest Ohio, logistics operations, and industrial real estate,” says Harmon. “We are proud to work with the Southward family on a transition to their next chapter.”
